name: OWO World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Meanstreak took the belt from the Crow in a First Blood match, then turned back a non-title grudge match against "Iceman" Josh Cagle days later — the only title change this wing's surviving record shows.

name: OWO Xtreme Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Held by Raven across this wing's surviving record; retained against Terminator when a countout finish denied the challenger the title under the fed's own titles-don't-change-on-a-countout rule.
